name: Health is the foundation of everything, so we should pay more attention to our physical and mental well-being.
trans: 健康是一切的基础，因此我们应更加关注身心健康。

name: Keeping a balanced diet and taking regular exercise are effective ways to stay healthy.
trans: 保持均衡饮食和定期锻炼是保持健康的有效方法。

name: As college students, we should form healthy eating habits and avoid junk food.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该养成健康饮食习惯，避免垃圾食品。

name: Staying up late may lead to poor health and lower learning efficiency.
trans: 熬夜可能导致健康不佳和学习效率下降。

name: We should strike a balance between work and rest instead of studying day and night.
trans: 我们应该劳逸结合，而不是日夜学习。

name: Regular exercise not only builds up our body but also helps relieve stress.
trans: 定期锻炼不仅能增强体质，还有助于缓解压力。

name: Mental health is as important as physical health, and we should not ignore it.
trans: 心理健康和身体健康同样重要，我们不应忽视它。

name: When we feel anxious or depressed, we can seek professional help or talk with friends.
trans: 当我们感到焦虑或抑郁时，可以寻求专业帮助或与朋友交谈。

name: Developing health awareness is essential for young people to lead a healthy lifestyle.
trans: 培养健康意识对年轻人过健康生活方式至关重要。

name: Reducing screen time and getting enough sleep can improve our health and study efficiency.
trans: 减少屏幕使用时间和保证充足睡眠能改善我们的健康和学习效率。

name: Health education plays an important role in helping students stay away from bad habits.
trans: 健康教育在帮助学生远离不良习惯方面起着重要作用。

name: Only by developing good habits can we enjoy a healthy and happy life.
trans: 只有养成良好习惯，我们才能享有健康快乐的生活。

name: It is widely acknowledged that health is more important than wealth.
trans: 众所周知，健康比财富更重要。

name: There is no denying that a healthy lifestyle contributes to both physical and mental well-being.
trans: 不可否认，健康的生活方式有助于身心健康。

name: As college students, we should take regular exercise and strike a balance between work and rest.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该定期锻炼，劳逸结合。

name: Only by forming good habits can we stay healthy and study efficiently.
trans: 只有养成良好习惯，我们才能保持健康、高效学习。

name: Taking regular exercise not only builds up our body but also helps relieve stress.
trans: 定期锻炼不仅能增强体质，还有助于缓解压力。

name: While study is important, we should also pay attention to our health.
trans: 虽然学习很重要，但我们也应关注健康。
